title: Moscow Cathedral Mosque
source: Retained exact way, normal viewer PMTiles/DEM and two inspected pictures.
identityStatus: Retained exact way 128264422 / Q3679864 is current viewer building 35184500353254. Its nine current outer vertices, original anchor and heading remain unchanged. reconstruction.heightBasis: No retained or current mapped height values are available. Explicit visualization estimates: main body eaves 22 m, stepped central support 26 m, drum 28–35 m, broad golden onion 35–47 m and finial 50 m. Two western minarets rise from rectangular 31 m bases through stepped octagonal window tiers near 33–48, 50–61 and 63–69 m, to gilded cones at 78 m and finials at 80 m. Northeastern smaller gold turret top about 40 m; southeastern teal turret top about 34 m. Roof steps, minor teal caps, cornices, parapets and pointed gables are estimates. These are visualization dimensions, not surveyed facts. Fine calligraphy, lattice patterns, sculpture and unseen interiors omitted.
reconstruction.scope: Individual medium-fi modern main Moscow Cathedral Mosque: broad golden onion dome, two tall stepped minarets with gilded cones, smaller gold/teal corner turrets, pale multi-level body, nested tall turquoise pointed windows, cornice bands and simplified parapets. Raw main outline retained; all detailed plans and heights estimated from two pictures. Six existing shared 256² graphs, seven merged roles and four budgeted browser LODs. Separate northern low building, city, fine artwork and unseen interiors remain outside this asset.
